description: The dataset records snow and ice measurements from 20 observations collected during the 2021‑2022 field season. Each record is identified by an Event code, with 13 distinct event identifiers serving as aggregation keys. Geographic coordinates are provided as latitude (‑73.37 to 0) and longitude (‑14.27 to 0), pinpointing the sampling locations. Snow and ice depth are captured in three columns – total depth, top layer, and bottom layer – ranging from 0 to 5.135 m. Corresponding snow density values span 0 to 513 kg m⁻³. A timestamp with second‑level precision marks when each measurement was taken. These variables support glaciological analyses such as spatial mapping of snowpack thickness, temporal trends in snow density, and assessment of melt‑water potential.
